      "rule": {
        "type": "edit_check",
        "description": "Screening endoscopy must be performed between Day -35 and Day -6 prior to Randomisation (Visit 2).",
        "when": "days_between(ENDO.ENDODTC, $V2.DATE) < 6 or days_between(ENDO.ENDODTC, $V2.DATE) > 35",
        "then_action": "open_query",
        "then_events": [],
        "then_message": "Screening endoscopy date must be between 35 and 6 days prior to Visit 2 (Day -35 to Day -6).",
        "scope_form": "ENDO",
        "scope_events": ["V1"]
      },
      "item": null,
      "source_change_ids": ["CH-7"],
      "source_page": 34,
      "source_quote": "4. During Day -35 to Day-6 prior to Randomisation, an endoscopy subscore ≥2.",
      "basis": "interpreted",
      "rationale": "Check that the screening endoscopy date at V1 falls within the shortened window of Day -35 to Day -6 relative to V2.",
      "uncertainty": ""
    },

        "then_events": [],

        "scope_form": "EX",

      },
      "item": null,

      "basis": "interpreted",
      "rationale": "Verify that the duration between start and end of IMP administration is exactly 2 hours now that the ± 3 minutes tolerance was removed.",

    {
      "op_id": "OP-12",
      "kind": "add_rule",
      "target_id": "CMP_PK_SUB_01",
      "label": "",
      "group": "",

      "rule": {

        "then_action": "open_query",
        "then_events": [],
        "then_message": "PK subgroup sample timepoint (48 h, 144 h, or 240 h) entered for a subject not in the PK substudy.",
        "scope_form": "PK",
        "scope_events": ["V2", "V7", "V8"]
      },
      "item": null,
      "source_change_ids": ["CH-4", "CH-5", "CH-15"],
      "source_page": 27,
      "source_quote": "At 1st dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 6), and 240 (Day 10) h after the start of the 1st administration;",
      "basis": "interpreted",
      "rationale": "Under Option B, 48 h, 144 h, and 240 h PK samples are consolidated onto parent visits V2, V7, and V8; this check ensures those subgroup timepoints are only collected when PKSUB is Yes.",
      "uncertainty": ""
    }
